fact: ARMP says SIGMAP, the platform to dematerialise public procurement, is not yet in production: training of trainers, users and administrators comes first, after a decree on electronic procurement (14 October 2024) and a roadmap adopted 18 October 2024.

ARMP says the SIGMAP e-procurement platform, launched in August 2022, has not reached production because of obstacles, and pilot procurement cells were equipped via World Bank projects (meeting of 17 March 2026).

COREF reports the President launched the SIGMAP public procurement management system, developed by the Budget Ministry, on 29 August 2022 and asked government to extend it to all other public entities under the 2010 procurement law.

Ecofin Agency says DRC authorities have begun digitizing procurement through SIGMAP, an electronic platform launched in August 2022 whose rollout faced delays, with a shared services centre launched in June 2026; it does not say tenders are bid online.
